comprehension.statement: Conditional forward simulation for all admitted candidate choices: each finite completed candidate event trace has a reference witness with identical finite public words and related final states. Successive matching also supplies an infinite reference witness when infinitely many candidate macrosteps complete.
comprehension.premises: Related initial states, a common admitted-event contract, candidate enabledness at every related pair and admitted input, universal candidate termination and matching, related successors, and an interface accounting for all observations and excluding internal divergence or hidden evidence consumption.
comprehension.property_transfer: Universal properties of public traces transfer when they hold on every matching reference execution. An event-count authorization guarantee transfers in its corresponding admitted scenario. Fairness and future inputs are assumed, not established. Real-time deadlines require matching timed observations or an independent candidate scheduling bound.
comprehension.guard_corollary: A reference reachability invariant can make a pure branch decision constant. Guard evaluation must have no additional observable effects, every entry and mutation must preserve the invariant, and the remaining simulation obligations must still hold.
comprehension.counterexample_checks: Candidate deadlock on an admitted next event violates explicit enabledness. Infinite internal computation violates termination/interface premises. A nondeterministic bad candidate branch is covered by the universal candidate-step quantifier. An unfair reference witness cannot establish a property known only for fair reference runs because the proof explicitly requires reference properties on every matching execution. Faster average calls do not establish the timed corollary. A side-effecting guard or missed entry invalidates the guard premises.

remaining_application_obligations: Define the complete public and timed interface, admitted faults/interleavings, initial-state relation, and corresponding scenario classes before applying this theorem.
Prove candidate enabledness, termination and matching for every reachable related pair and every admitted candidate choice; finite tests alone do not discharge these quantified premises.

When reference liveness is proved only under fairness, establish that each constructed matching reference witness satisfies the necessary fairness condition, or prove the property on all matching witnesses. Prefix closure of finite input histories alone does not establish infinite-run fairness.
Establish that the environment supplies the future admitted events needed for any event-count or infinite-run guarantee.
Supply a complete timed model or a verified candidate scheduling/deadline bound for real-time claims.
For guard specialization, prove the invariant across every entry and intervening mutation, account for all guard evaluation effects, and preserve the other transitions of the state relation.
No concrete kernel refinement, firmware readiness, deployment certificate, or target resource bound follows from this generic theorem.

review_scope.method: Independent semantic reconstruction and attempted counterexamples; no empirical test is presented as proof.
